description: The top-level keys of a instrument entry in a setup file, as imswitch.imcontrol.model.SetupInfo.InstrumentInfo declares them. managerProperties is described per manager under managers/. Keys the dataclass does not declare are kept but not read.

analogChannel.description: Channel for analog communication. ``null`` if the device is digital or doesn't use NI-DAQ. If an integer is specified, it will be translated to "Dev1/ao{analogChannel}".

connectOnStartup.description: For a transient device: still try to connect at startup; a failure leaves it absent with the error shown, never in mock.

digitalLine.description: Line for digital communication. ``null`` if the device is analog or doesn't use NI-DAQ. If an integer is specified, it will be translated to "Dev1/port0/line{digitalLine}".

managerProperties.description: Properties to be read by the manager. Empty when omitted.

preparation.description: Time from the request of the device's state (the line's edge, or the command) until it is ready (a shutter fully open, a laser emitting at its set level): ``"notRequired"``, ``{"durationS": seconds}`` or ``"unknown"``. Absent is not zero: see the scan-program plan, §2.4.

transient.description: Declared but not required at startup: left absent (not an error, no mock) until connected from the Hardware status window or a script. For devices that are plugged in only when needed.

ttlActiveLevel.description: The electrical level of the ``digitalLine`` that means *on*: ``"high"`` (default) or ``"low"`` for an inverted input. Every path that drives the line -- a scan, manual control, stopping, failure cleanup -- maps the device's logical on/off through it.

title: instrument device entry (InstrumentInfo)
